content.page_title: Multidisciplinary team management for the prevention and treatment of chronic heart failure

sections.section_title: Multidisciplinary team management for the prevention and treatment of chronic heart failure

sections.notes: General advice about risk factors for the development of HF and strategies to prevent HF early in the cardiovascular continuum; references supplementary figures and tables.

recommendations.text: Screening for, and treatment of, aetiologies, and cardiovascular and non-cardiovascular comorbidities is recommended in patients with HFpEF (see relevant sections of this document).
Diuretics are recommended in congested patients with HFpEF in order to alleviate symptoms and signs.

abbreviations.HFpEF: heart failure with preserved ejection fraction

content.visual_notes: Two identical recommendation tables are shown on the page; HFpEF and explanatory footnotes (a = Class of recommendation; b = Level of evidence) appear multiple times.
